title: Custom 500 Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Bell Custom 500 Gloss Black is crafted for classic motorcycle enthusiasts seeking unrestricted peripheral sightlines. Featuring a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) architecture at a featherweight 1104g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~96 dB aero profile. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: The original helmet design, updated with modern technology.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Open face design offers unrestricted peripheral vision; Gloss Black finish may show fingerprints; Bell Custom 500 fits most head shapes but requires cheek pad adjustment for optimal fit.

yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Bell Custom 500 Gloss Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.
technical_analysis: Features 3K Carbon Fiber shell featuring Flex Impact Liner with progressive three-layer density rotational energy management paired with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view. The interior utilizes Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Bell Custom 500 Gloss Black: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view and Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner engineered for open-air comfort and easy maintenance.

yoast_title: Bell Custom 500 Gloss Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
introduction: Positioned in Bell's Open Face lineup, the Custom 500 Gloss Black brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Bell Custom 500 Gloss Black represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~96 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bell Custom 500 Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
